diagnostics.message: aws_lambda_function.dispatcher is created before aws_cloudwatch_log_group.dispatcher (the log group's name is derived from the function's function_name, forcing the function to be created first). In the real world the log group must exist before the function: the dispatcher lambda is wired to aws_cloudwatch_event_rule.workflow_job via aws_cloudwatch_event_target.dispatcher, so once events flow the function can be invoked before Terraform creates the log group — Lambda then auto-creates "/aws/lambda/${var.config.prefix}-dispatch-to-runner" with default settings (never-expiring retention), and the subsequent aws_cloudwatch_log_group.dispatcher create fails with ResourceAlreadyExistsException. Add `depends_on = [aws_cloudwatch_log_group.dispatcher]` to the function. Note this requires breaking the name cycle: express the log group name from the config directly (e.g. name = "/aws/lambda/${var.config.prefix}-dispatch-to-runner") instead of referencing aws_lambda_function.dispatcher.function_name, otherwise the added depends_on would create a dependency cycle.

aws_lambda_function.webhook is created before aws_cloudwatch_log_group.webhook (the log group's name is derived from the function's function_name, forcing the function to be created first). In the real world the log group must exist before the function: if the function is invoked (e.g. via the API Gateway permission attached to it) before Terraform creates the log group, Lambda auto-creates "/aws/lambda/${var.config.prefix}-webhook" with default settings (never-expiring retention, default class/KMS settings), and the subsequent aws_cloudwatch_log_group.webhook create then fails with ResourceAlreadyExistsException. Add `depends_on = [aws_cloudwatch_log_group.webhook]` to the function. Note this requires breaking the name cycle: express the log group name from the config directly (e.g. name = "/aws/lambda/${var.config.prefix}-webhook") instead of referencing aws_lambda_function.webhook.function_name, otherwise the added depends_on would create a dependency cycle.
